No GPU models, prices, benchmark scores or model context sizes are written; Apple's on-device and PCC token limits and daily quota were seen on the official pages but deliberately left out as product snapshots. Source vs brief: Apple's Foundation Models framework, which the catalogue lists as an on-device source, now also routes to Private Cloud Compute and other server models through the same API; the article uses this as the main example of why 'built-in model' does not mean 'local'. Microsoft's two pages describe Foundry Local's network use slightly differently (what-is page: model/component downloads plus optional diagnostics; Windows FAQ: initial download plus optional catalog refresh, 'only network traffic'); the article lists the union and does not claim either is exhaustive. The meeting-notes walk-through is an original illustrative example, labelled unmeasured. Diagram carries no numbers other than the drawing year 2026.
